Against this, E1's July payroll decline of 23,000 and combined downward revisions of 103,000 to May and June materially strengthen the case for easing. E2's subdued monthly headline inflation and declining annual core inflation give the Fed more room to cut, although headline annual inflation remains elevated at 3.4%.
